Name: Soy Bean Meats for Animal Husbandry
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][center][i][color=#fff2cc]Even wanted to cook delicious meat dishes without need in killing poor animals? Now you can! Just plant some soy beans and make meats out of it![/color][/i]

This mod is a simple and small expansion for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry (formerly Butcher Mod)[/url]. It adds new method of getting meat items with new soybean crop.
Compatible with:
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25028]Mizu's Quail[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]Mizu's Turkey![/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515?tab=description]Alpacas[/url]﻿
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22597]The Dwarven Expansion[/url]﻿


--------------------------------------
[u][color=#fff2cc]﻿Big thanks to HonestlyVitali for commissioning me on this mod and allowing to upload it here on Nexus! Original idea for soy bean crop and machine belongs to them.[/color][/u][/center][/size]


[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]What's added:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2][color=#fff2cc]Soy Bean Crop[/color] - Pierre will start selling soybean seeds at Fall 1 (You can change it to sell at every season in mod's confg). You'll receive a special mail telling you that Pierre expanded his stock. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=2]      Seeds cost 40g, takes 10 days to grow and continues to produce Soy Beans after maturity.

[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2][color=#fff2cc]Soy Beans item[/color] - Falls in Vegetable category, sells for 50g, universaly neutral gift (except George and Andy - they dislike it)[/size][/font]
[/list]     Put those in Mill to get Soy Flour.

[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2][color=#fff2cc]Soy Flour [/color]- Falls in Artisan Goods category, sells for 60g, universaly neutral gift. Can be used for producing various meats in Meat Synthesizer.[/size][/font]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2][color=#fff2cc]Meat Synthesizer [/color]- BigCraftable machine, Robin will start selling crafting recipe at Fall 1 for 1500g (You can change it to sell at every season in mod's confg). [/size][/font]
[/list][/size][/font]    [font=Comic Sans MS][size=3] Crafting recipe - 5 Iron Bars, 1 Battery Pack, 25 Slime. Put 1 animal related product + 1 Soy Flour into it to get animal related meat item. [/size][size=2]
[/size][size=3][center]-----------------------------------------[/center][/size]
[color=#d9ead3][size=3][b]HOW TO PUT ITEMS IN MEAT SYNTHESIZER: [/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]﻿Have at least 1 animal item and 1 Soy Flour item in your inventory![/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]﻿Interact with Meat Synthesizer while holding animal item in your hands (For example, hold 1 Egg and interact with the machine, it will consume 1 Egg and 1 Soy Flour and start making meat).[/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#d9ead3][size=3][b]Meat Recipes:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Egg/Large Egg[/color] + Soy flour =  Chicken Meat[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Duck Egg + Soy[/color] flour =  Duck Meat[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Ostrich Egg[/color] + Soy flour =  Ostrich Meat[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Milk/Large Milk [/color]+ Soy flour =  Beef Meat[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Wool[/color] + Soy flour =  Mutton Meat[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Truffle[/color] + Soy flour = Pork Meat[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Rabbit's Foot[/color] + Soy flour = Rabbit Meat[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3]-------------------[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Quail Egg[/color]  + Soy flour = Quail Meat[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Turkey Egg[/color][color=#d9ead3] [/color]+ Soy flour = Turkey Meat[/size][/font]
[*][size=3]Alpaca Wool  + Soy flour = Mutton Meat[/size]
[*][size=3]Slime  + Soy flour = Bug Meat[/size]
[*][size=3]Bug Meat  + Soy flour = Crab[/size]
[*][size=3]10 Cave Carrots   + Soy flour = Molerat Meat[/size]
[/list][size=3][center]-----------------------------------------[/center][/size]
[color=#d9ead3][size=3][b]Config options:[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Seed Packet Style - Vanilla, Fancy[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Crop Style - Default, Trellis[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Pierre sells seeds only at Fall - true, false[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Robin Sells recipe only at Fall - true, false[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]SoyBean crop grows only at Fall - true, false[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3][center]
-----------------------------------------[/center][/size][center][/center][/font]
